say:1:1623131001:1.text: Magic can do a thousand things... but it's not great at filling an empty heart. You managed it anyway.
say:1:1623131001:1.source_cn: 魔法虽然有无数作用，但却很难安抚生灵空虚的内心，但你做到了。
say:1:1623131001:1.male: Magic can do a thousand things... but it's not great at filling an empty heart. You managed it anyway.
say:1:1623131001:1.female: Magic can do a thousand things... but it's not great at filling an empty heart. You managed it anyway.

say:2:1623131002:1.text: Magic is one of the things that drives Esperia forward. Its value is beyond question.
say:2:1623131002:1.source_cn: 魔法是伊索米亚发展的基石之一，它的伟大毋庸置疑。
say:2:1623131002:1.male: Magic is one of the things that drives Esperia forward. Its value is beyond question.
say:2:1623131002:1.female: Magic is one of the things that drives Esperia forward. Its value is beyond question.

say:3:1623131003:1.text: Still, does magic make our hearts fuller, not just our lives easier? Hmm... an interesting topic for another day.
